scripts.start: HOST=${HOST:-127.0.0.1}; PORT=${PORT:-3000}; pids=$(lsof -tiTCP:$PORT -sTCP:LISTEN 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$pids" ]; then kill $pids 2>/dev/null || true; sleep 1; pids=$(lsof -tiTCP:$PORT -sTCP:LISTEN 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$pids" ]; then kill -9 $pids 2>/dev/null || true; fi; fi; bun pages/*.html --host=$HOST:$PORT
scripts.build: rm -rf docs && mkdir -p docs/source && bun build /home/rock/Workspaces/dynamic_flow_controller/pages/bad-apple-outline.ts --outfile /home/rock/Workspaces/dynamic_flow_controller/docs/bad-apple-outline.js --target browser --format esm && cp /home/rock/Workspaces/dynamic_flow_controller/index.html /home/rock/Workspaces/dynamic_flow_controller/docs/index.html && cp /home/rock/Workspaces/dynamic_flow_controller/source/video.mp4 /home/rock/Workspaces/dynamic_flow_controller/docs/source/video.mp4 && if [ -f /home/rock/Workspaces/dynamic_flow_controller/source/audio.mp3 ]; then cp /home/rock/Workspaces/dynamic_flow_controller/source/audio.mp3 /home/rock/Workspaces/dynamic_flow_controller/docs/source/audio.mp3; fi
